info.title: Aurora Staff BFF — Documents/OCR contract
info.description: Deterministic FE contract fixture for the source-backed Documents/OCR upload and intake workflow. It is intentionally sanitized: signed URL values, tenant IDs, storage credentials and authentication cookies are never included. The fixture is source-derived because runtime Swagger serialization was unavailable in the isolated finalization clone; Staff.Bff.Tests validates the paths, permissions, DTO shapes and response metadata against the controllers.

post.description: Creates a tenant-scoped upload session. The response writeUrl is a short-lived, write-only object-storage URL; the BFF does not receive file bytes.
Verifies the upload, creates or replays one DocumentOcr job, and consumes the upload only after durable job persistence.
Retained storageReference-based submission. New FE code must use uploads and intakes.
Retained storageReference-based submission. New FE code must use uploads and intakes.

storageReference.description: Opaque server-owned object reference; never construct in the browser.

writeUrl.description: Short-lived write-only URL returned by the server for the browser upload.
